_comment: Per storyline type, several text variants with {placeholders} (more variants = less repetition across a season). Editable by the league without touching code. render.js fills {name1}/{name2}/etc from facts + league-lore.json (rotating in a nickname ~30% of the time), and picks which variant to use, steering away from wordings that type used in the last few recaps -- all choices seeded by (gw, dedupeKey) so a rerun never changes past recaps. League vocabulary: the title is always "the Belt"; winning it is "winning the Belt".
